projects.title: Roomly
projects.headline: Roomly: sell the whole room
projects.desc: A move-out marketplace for students. You photograph a room once, a vision model drafts a priced listing for every item, and buyers walk through the room in 3D.
projects.myPart: Everything: the product, the vision pipeline, the 3D room, the offer flow and the demo.

media.alt: A student bedroom rebuilt in 3D by the Roomly app, turning slowly, with a price tag floating over each item

result.text: photos of my own bedroom became priced items in one pass

projects.title: Line-following race robot
projects.headline: A line-following robot with a hand-written turn
projects.desc: A race robot that follows a taped line, turns 180° at a wall without the library's turn command, and runs home against the robot in the next lane.
projects.myPart: I worked on the race program and its tuning with my team.
projects.team: Course team. The robot is an XRP kit; the program is ours.

media.alt: Two robots racing in parallel lanes on a table, out along the tape, around at the wall and back

result.text: in a race program that ran hands-off in head-to-head races

projects.title: SARAH
projects.headline: SARAH: a command center for my day
projects.desc: A dashboard on my laptop that runs my job search and daily routine from one screen. One Python server, one HTML page, 47 commits.
projects.myPart: All of it, built with Claude Code as a pair programmer.

media.alt: The SARAH dashboard's Today screen with sample data: the next task, the day's numbers and a task list

result.text: in under five months, two files and 6,841 lines

projects.title: Self-built drones
projects.headline: Three UAVs, designed and built on my own
projects.desc: Three drones on my own time and money: a mapping aircraft that flies waypoint missions, a quadcopter frame tuned from its flight logs, and a thermal-imaging drone I am assembling now.
projects.myPart: All of it: component trade studies, frame design and FEA, Pixhawk integration, mission planning, and tuning from flight logs.
projects.team: Solo. Nobody assigns these; I set the problem and pay for the parts.

media.alt: Timelapse of me assembling a quadcopter airframe at my desk

result.text: of flight data behind the PID retune that removed a hover oscillation

projects.title: Nittany Rocket Labs
projects.headline: Composite airframe structures at Nittany Rocket Labs
projects.desc: Structures and composites on Penn State's student rocketry team: manufacturable CAD, fit prototypes and stiffness and buckling checks for carbon-fiber airframe parts.
projects.myPart: Manufacturable CAD and fit prototypes, stiffness and buckling checks, and simple FE models compared with hand calculations.
projects.team: Structures team. The layup and build work is shared.

media.alt: Gloved hands rolling carbon fiber onto a mandrel on a lab table covered in release film, with a cut sheet of carbon cloth beside them

result.text: prototypes settle fit and clearance before any carbon is cut

projects.title: Capstone payload pickup
projects.headline: A payload pickup for an autonomous quadcopter
projects.desc: The payload pickup for our senior capstone quadcopter, from a passive ratchet to a servo winch, plus the analysis of what a 100 g package does to the vehicle.
projects.myPart: I designed the pickup mechanism, from a passive ratchet to a servo winch, and produced the stability and control analysis for the design review.
projects.team: Team of 4. Each of us owns part of the vehicle; these two pieces are mine.

media.alt: Schematic of the two pickup concepts: a passive ratchet tube that lifts the package 30 millimeters, and a servo winch that lowers a magnet puck 150 millimeters

result.text: for the ratchet pickup, against an 80 g mass budget

projects.title: Analysis, checked twice
projects.headline: Four analyses, each checked a second way
projects.desc: A carbon-reinforced beam test, a transonic airfoil rebuilt from raw CFD data, an EV drag study and a root solver, each checked a second way.
projects.myPart: My own work throughout, except the root solver, which I wrote with one teammate.
projects.team: Individual, except the root solver (two of us).

media.alt: Bar chart of the measured stiffness of a plain aluminum beam and a carbon-reinforced one

result.text: bending stiffness from carbon reinforcement, for 18.6% more weight

projects.title: Safran Aerosystems
projects.headline: Fuel-system production and test at Safran Aerosystems
projects.desc: A summer in production and test of aircraft fuel-system parts: standardizing test records, updating work instructions and compiling data packs for failed parts.
projects.myPart: I assisted production and test, then changed the records, instructions and failure packs described here.

media.alt: Diagram of the test-to-closure loop for a part, with three numbered places where I changed the process

result.text: of data entry saved on every test, 5 to 8%
